text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9396TX is a feature-rich and highly scalable line-rate 10GBase-T switch ideal for top-of-rack deployments in both traditional and ACI-enabled enterprise, service provider, and cloud environments.

graphic.text: The Cisco Nexus 9396TX is a feature-rich and highly scalable line-rate 10GBase-T switch ideal for top-of-rack deployments in both traditional and ACI-enabled enterprise, service provider, and cloud environments.

text.text: The Cisco Nexus 9396TX access switch delivers 1.28 Tbps of throughput and line rate performance in a 2-rack-unit (2RU) form factor and offers: Connectivity options that include 100 Mbps, 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps and 40Gbps speeds Deployment options in traditional three-tier designs or as a leaf node in spine-leaf architectures Either NX-OS or ACI modes of operation

graphic.text:
The Cisco Nexus 9396TX access switch delivers 1.28 Tbps of throughput and line rate performance in a 2-rack-unit (2RU) form factor and offers:
Connectivity options that include 100 Mbps, 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps and 40Gbps speeds
Deployment options in traditional three-tier designs or as a leaf node in spine-leaf architectures
Either NX-OS or ACI modes of operation

text.text: The Nexus 9396TX offers a non-blocking architecture with 960Gbps bandwidth capacity that supports: 48 fixed 10GBASE-T ports that can run at 100M/1GE/10GE speeds 40GbE connectivity through a 12 port QSFP+ Uplink Module 52 MB of shared buffer Line-rate VXLAN bridging, routing, and gateway support Fibre Channel over Ethernet (FCoE) capability Front-to-back or back-to-front airflow Sub 2 microsecond latency

graphic.text:
The Nexus 9396TX offers a non-blocking architecture with 960Gbps bandwidth capacity that supports:
48 fixed 10GBASE-T ports that can run at 100M/1GE/10GE speeds
40GbE connectivity through a 12 port QSFP+ Uplink Module
52 MB of shared buffer
Line-rate VXLAN bridging, routing, and gateway support
Fibre Channel over Ethernet (FCoE) capability
Front-to-back or back-to-front airflow
Sub 2 microsecond latency

text.text: Provides 40 Gigabit Ethernet connectivity for uplinks to aggregation or spine switches Supports Cisco Bidirectional (BiDi) Transceivers enabling 40Gbps connectivity using existing 10 Gigabit Ethernet fiber 10 Gigabit connectivity through a QSA adapter
